speak.title: Role-play: an invitation to volunteer
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You help at a local reading group for adults. You need one more helper on Thursday evenings and you think your friend would be good at it. Persuade your friend to try one evening.

b.role: the friend who is not sure
b.text: Your friend has asked you to help adults who are learning to read. You like the idea, but you're busy and you're worried you won't know what to say. Ask questions and agree what you can offer.

phrases: I'd love to help, but I'm not sure I'm the right person.
What if I say the wrong thing?
You don't need to be an expert, you just need to be patient.
I can't do Tuesdays, but I could manage Thursdays.
That's fair, let's try one session and see.
Would it help if we went together the first time?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class what you agreed, and whether you both felt it was a fair deal.
